body: Regression from T-164: the host root is derived from cwd, so `cd .agents/skills/gittoc && scripts/setup` sees the clone's own toplevel == GITTOC_DIR and refuses. Derive the host root from the gittoc dir's parent, and detect a dev checkout by its own state (local gittoc branch, extra local branches, dirty tree) rather than by cwd.
title: setup: refusal check misdetects a fresh vendored clone when run from inside it
